description: This file defines the 'Cell' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages the data, styling, and behavior of individual cells in a spreadsheet, including value handling, styling, formulas, hyperlinks, and merge ranges.

classes.name: Cell
classes.description: Represents a single cell in a spreadsheet, providing methods for managing its value, style, formulas, hyperlinks, merge state, and interaction with the parent worksheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Cell with a given value, data type, and parent worksheet.

methods.name: updateInCollection
methods.description: Updates the cell's data within the parent collection.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the cell from its parent collection.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches the cell to a given collection of cells.

methods.name: getColumn
methods.description: Returns the column coordinate of the cell.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Returns the row number of the cell.

methods.name: getCoordinate
methods.description: Returns the cell's coordinate as a string like 'A1'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value stored in the cell.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the cell's value formatted as a string according to its number format.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the cell's value with automatic datatype detection or via a specified binder.

methods.name: setValueExplicit
methods.description: Sets the cell's value and explicitly defines its data type, bypassing automatic detection.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the cell.

methods.name: setDataType
methods.description: Sets the data type of the cell.

methods.name: isFormula
methods.description: Determines if the cell contains a formula.

methods.name: hasDataValidation
methods.description: Checks if the cell has data validation rules.

methods.name: getDataValidation
methods.description: Retrieves data validation rules for the cell.

methods.name: setDataValidation
methods.description: Sets data validation rules for the cell.

methods.name: hasValidValue
methods.description: Validates whether the cell's value passes data validation rules.

methods.name: hasHyperlink
methods.description: Checks if the cell contains a hyperlink.

methods.name: getHyperlink
methods.description: Retrieves the hyperlink object associated with the cell.

methods.name: setHyperlink
methods.description: Assigns a hyperlink to the cell.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the collection to which this cell belongs.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Returns the parent worksheet of the cell.

methods.name: getWorksheetOrNull
methods.description: Returns the parent worksheet or null if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: isInMergeRange
methods.description: Checks if the cell is part of a merge range.

methods.name: isMergeRangeValueCell
methods.description: Checks if the cell is the primary (top-left) cell in a merge range.

methods.name: getMergeRange
methods.description: Returns the merge range this cell belongs to.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the style object applied to the cell.

methods.name: getAppliedStyle
methods.description: Returns the style object considering conditional styles.

methods.name: rebindParent
methods.description: Rebinds the cell to a different parent worksheet.

methods.name: isInRange
methods.description: Checks if the cell falls within a specific range.

methods.name: compareCells
methods.description: Compares two cells for ordering.

methods.name: getValueBinder
methods.description: Returns the value binder instance used for binding values.

methods.name: setValueBinder
methods.description: Sets a custom value binder.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Clones the cell object, creating a deep copy.

methods.name: getXfIndex
methods.description: Returns the index to the cell's style XF.

methods.name: setXfIndex
methods.description: Sets the index to the cell's style XF.

methods.name: setFormulaAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes related to formulas.

methods.name: getFormulaAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves formula-related attributes.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the cell (its value).

methods.name: getIgnoredErrors
methods.description: Returns the IgnoredErrors object for the cell.
